dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: #Hm. You look troubled, {NICKNAME}. Are you worried about the enemies we will soon face?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I see... Sorry, I should have noticed sooner. You asked me to join your team — it is only right that I share this burden with you.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: The Dandelion Knight's sword is at your command. Let us proceed.
